messages:
anya: Hey all — first day as Product Designer here! Quick onboarding Qs: I don't have access to the Redwood Design Figma org yet, and I can't find the product roadmap Notion or the UX research repo. Who's the right person to ping for access? Also curious about our research process (templates, consent forms, recruitment).

ryan: welcome @anya :wave: I’m design ops — I'll check invites. I just sent a Figma org invite to the work email I have on file. Check spam and 'Hidden' tabs. If you don't see it, DM me your exact email and I'll re-send. Figma team link (internal): https://www.figma.com/files/team/REDACTED

sophia: hi @anya, congrats and welcome! Roadmap lives in Notion under /Product/Roadmap and we keep PRDs there too. If you don't have Notion access yet, say so here and I can grant read access on a quick pass.

anya: thanks — I tried Notion and got a 403. Figma invite still hasn't appeared for me (checked spam).

ryan: okay noted. I escalated the SSO invite with infra (ticket #INF-1122). Meanwhile I'm pasting the most common starter files in this thread and in #product-docs. Direct Figma file (components): https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/Redwood-Components — open that URL and let me know error text if any.

lee: FYI on research ops: templates (consent, screener, discussion guides) are in Drive > UX > Templates. We use Notion for structured research notes and tagging. Recruitment is either internal panel (contact ops) or vendor (maria@researchagency.com). Legal reviews consent wording — @legal should be looped for external participant recruitment.

sophia: quick onboarding tip: there's an "Onboarding checklist" Notion template under /Product/Playbooks that covers design setup, access steps, and who-to-ask. I can run through it with you — free for a 20-min sync at 3pm today?

anya: 3pm works for me. Also: where do we store session recordings? Drive or Notion?

ryan: recordings go to Drive > UX Recordings; notes go to Notion and link to the recording. If Notion is blocked, we temporarily drop notes in Drive and I'll migrate them.

design-bot: :robot_face: Invite sent to anya@redwood.com for Figma org 'Redwood Design' (expires in 7 days).

anya: Got the Figma invite! I can see the components file :tada: — Notion still 403 though.

ryan: sweet — adding you to the 'Product Designers' team in Figma now. I'm escalating Notion with infra and will update this thread when it's cleared. For now, here's a zip of starter tokens/components: https://drive.google.com/uc?id=REDACTED

sophia: @anya once Notion access is unblocked I'll add you to the weekly design critique calendar and the onboarding doc. Also ping me if you'd like to shadow a research session this week.

anya: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick help. I'll ping here if Notion is still blocked after 5pm. Looking forward to the 3pm walkthrough!
